Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Anand Sen. I am a 37-year-old government clerk living in Coimbatore. Joseph Tiwari gave me a cheque for Rs 22,40,000 to repay a loan, but the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 83957 84757 or email anand.sen75@example.com.
